_comment: CAPABILITY suite for the PostgreSQL CDC stream source, over logical decoding (wal2json) of a employeescdc domain: every table of the model -- one table per way a row is identified: accounts (a primary key every update CHANGES), ledger (a composite primary key), devices (no primary key, a unique index), readings (no primary key and no index) -- and its xp_sentinel. Functions in functions/caps_postgrescdc.py: four @stream_publisher variants, each in its own collection: postgrescdc_in (start_from=tail, flattened tabular rows), postgrescdc_head (start_from=head), postgrescdc_struct (columns_format=struct, flatten_columns=False), postgrescdc_map (columns_format=map). STAGES: (1) domains -- create the domain, install the employeescdc model, load the xs seed, its operations appended to ${XP_WORK_DIR}/ops.jsonl (--emit-ops) -- as every data command below appends its own; (2) collections and (3) functions -- registering a stream publisher STARTS it (no trigger); (4) actions, tagged live -- a 30s pause for the tail streams to attach (a change before that is not theirs to see), one `modify-data --ops Mix --sets 30` pass (every set one transaction of one verb over all four tables: inserts, updates -- accounts' moving its key -- and deletes), then `sentinel-data --key after-changes`; (5) sentinel -- hold until after-changes is in postgrescdc_in's and postgrescdc_head's xp_sentinel_changes (at most 5m); (6) actions, tagged check -- scripts/verify_cdc_ops.py checks postgrescdc_in from the tail (the changes after the stream attached, one by one, each with its whole before-image and the row it leaves) and postgrescdc_head: head reads from the slot's creation -- logical decoding keeps no WAL from before it -- so it is checked as a tail. postgrescdc_struct and postgrescdc_map run over the same changes, unchecked: their rows nest the values the check reads flat; (7) monitor. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite container-connectors/postgrescdc --keep`.
